fit_records.text: ATHENS | NEAR THE AREOPAGUS | A VESSEL FOR THE PROCESSION

fit_records.name: translation
fit_records.text:
Near the Areopagus there is shown a ship constructed for the procession of the
Panathenaia. Someone, I believe, has already made one even larger than this; but
as for the ship at Delos, I know of none yet that has surpassed it, as it holds nine
banks of rowers from the decks.

fit_records.name: interpretive-caption
fit_records.text:
Athens, near the Areopagus: an interpretive display of the Panathenaic procession ship on land. Hull, rig, wheeled support and
setting are conjectural. The Delian ship mentioned for comparison is not depicted; no exact ship design or display site is claimed.
